name: Idomoo
description: Israeli personalized and data-driven video platform (founded 2007) that renders individualized videos at scale for enterprises, especially banks, insurers and telecoms; its current product line includes the Lucas AI video creator. Clients have included Google, J.P. Morgan, Oracle and Fidelity.
notes: Filed for a TASE IPO in April 2021 (~$150M valuation target); whether it listed is unclear (one tracker shows ticker IDMO.TA) — funding.public left unset. Some sources place HQ in Hod Hasharon. other_offices from memory, unverified. 2020 revenue $8.7M.
